title: Excalibur | Easy Shulker Boxes Support
description: Retexture of Easy Shulker Boxes in Excalibur style
body:
[](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excalibur-easy-shulker-boxes-support) [](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-easy-shulker-boxes-support) ---
An **unofficial compatibility pack** designed to align the aesthetics of [Easy Shulker Box](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes) mod with the [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal) resource pack. This pack is **100% completed** and **should be adjusted** using the `Configuration Menu`, as follows: - Set `Item Storage Highlight Sprite = Selection` - Set `Item Storage Colors = Off` for better visuality. **Note:** - For the best experience, use this pack alongside [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal). - For Bug Report / Suggestion, please DM me on my **Discord (@thedatthai)**. **Credits:** - [Maffhew](https://modrinth.com/user/DTcBuGJU) - Creator of Excalibur - [Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/user/Fuzs) - Creator of Easy Shulker Boxes - Special thanks to [JohnMC](https://modrinth.com/user/JohnMC) for his erudition and dedication. Without his support, this addon would never been possible. ## Showcase: ![Showcase (GUI)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/982ce9ba06de1ddb2de45a1845bd79eb057461d4.png)
